description: INIT { STRATEGY WARM } from a bootstrapped seed_pot.tadah.

evaluations.note: 3 on the reference machine. The WARM start is on the upper bound RCUT2B = 6.0 (eval 1, the best), BFGS takes the one-sided gradient there (evals 2-3), and its first step cannot move the point: the line search is not run, and the objective-delta test ends the search ("DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached"). 1.5.0's fingerprint had 8 evaluations, with evals_tol 30.

tolerance_rationale: Best loss, components and RCUT2B are pinned at the default tolerances, and the evaluation count exactly: the WARM start is on the upper bound RCUT2B = 6.0 (eval 1), BFGS takes the one-sided gradient there (evals 2-3), and its first step cannot move the point, so its line search is not run and the objective-delta test ends the search, "DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached" (FTOL_ABS is 1e-7 by default), after 3 evaluations. No point is evaluated twice, so no decision of the search compares two relaxations of one point, which differ at the rounding level (~1e-13 relative: each PC_LAMMPS --hotvar relaxation starts from the value of the best evaluation so far).
